execution: Current-session independent Codex agents; not an application model API
blinding: Fresh-context executors received the frozen Skill/protocol and assigned inputs only; no expectations, evaluator feedback, prior outputs or production access.
attemptPolicy: First written output per case retained; no repair before first scoring.
review: Three different independent Codex agents reviewed disjoint case groups against the original input, output and frozen manual rubric; no human industry-user adjudication.
archiveNote: The first-run inputs, outputs, protocol and frozen expectations are immutable evidence. Later corpus corrections and Skill revisions are documented in grading-erratum.json and never replace the first result.
